title: The free energy of the Ising random perceptron
main_claim: Take the Gaussian Ising perceptron with uniform probability prior, pattern density alpha>0 and any bounded Borel log-potential f. Then E p_N(f), and p_N(f) in probability, converge to inf_q {alpha V_f(q) + S_I(q)}. Here V_f is the Parisi-type Gaussian pattern recursion and S_I(q) = sup_h {ell(h) + (1/2) int h q} is the dual of the log cosh field recursion. The paper also proves extensions to integrable unbounded f and to random-sign patterns.
coverage: I read the whole of introduction, model, variational, upper, bulk, cavity and extensions. Of arrays.tex I read only the lemma list and the fresh-pattern lemma; its ultrametricity, tilt-invariance and quantization lemmas are standard Panchenko / Bolthausen-Sznitman material and I took them as given. I hand-checked the following. (1) First variations, including the terminal field term -(1-zeta_{k-1})tanh^2/2. (2) The concavity proof of ell: the folded-kernel monotonicity, the cross-derivative sign for j>i (j<i follows by symmetry), the row-sum argument from increasing h_0, and the PSD decomposition identity. (3) The upper bound: the signs of J_N at t=0 and at t=alpha, the coercive field cap, the penalty and concentration rates (thermal N^{1/16}, disorder N^{5/16}, against the N^{7/16} field scale) and the derivation of the joint Ghirlanda-Guerra identities. Also the no-crossing synchronization, the cone inequality turning into tail order and then V_f(p)<=V_f(q), and the sign of the time derivative ending in a contradiction. (4) Bulk: the variance and rates (N^{-3/8} against s_N^2/N = N^{-1/4}, deviation N^{1/4} = o(N^{3/8})). Also that the two-omitted-pattern restoration makes the second moment of B equal int a^2 dmu, so that B = a(R), and the IBP balance c + a_d = int r a(r) dmu. (5) Cavity: the Taylor expansion giving L C_N/2, the Q removal, the cascade evaluation L(ell(h) + (c + a_d)/2) + d V_f, the coordinate-exchangeability identity giving rho_h = p with the sigma(p)-measurability argument, and the telescoping and averaging over good parameters. (6) Extensions: the e^{2K} L1(gamma) bounds via the telescoped path density, the integrable clipping bounds, the Lindeberg sign replacement and the linear-activation sanity check (V = t^2(1 - int q)/2).
sibling_notes: On the family-222 board, the only earlier entry was the spherical-family sibling 'Microscopic jamming in the negative spherical perceptron' (rank 59, no_gap_found).
